results.title: Control a real browser by voice. Jev (TypeSafe System One) decides intent + target in ~300 ms per spoken word; Playwright acts — often before the sentence ends.
results.role: 源头项目；jev-mac-voice 基于其改造（DEMO.md 保留 voice-browser 文案）

architecture.decision: 语音转写流 → 一次请求并行回答 11 个 yes/no + choice 问题（is_command、intent、目标元素、站点、文本跨度、'句子是否说完'、'是否破坏性'、滚动量、搜索文本跨度等）
architecture.speed: 首条 ~700 ms 预热，后续 ~300 ms；'act@word < total'——句子没说完浏览器就已行动
architecture.cost: $0.042/M 输入，输出免费；整个 demo 约 1 美分
architecture.execution: Playwright 执行；'That wasn't an LLM writing a plan. A model answered eleven yes/no and multiple-choice questions in three hundred milliseconds, and code did the rest.'
architecture.text_span: 键入文本不是生成的——代码从转写中切出候选跨度，Jev 只选一个
architecture.elements: 约 100 个可交互元素快照（viewport 优先，每个 ≤60 字符），作为 state 发送
architecture.ambiguity: 目标置信度 <0.45 → 页面编号蓝色徽标，用户说数字——'No model call for the number — that's a regex. Jev answers judgment, code answers arithmetic.'
architecture.gates: is_command <0.5 忽略（旁白 IGNORE）；破坏性动作需 CONFIRM 口述确认；门控表显示各阈值
architecture.pinning: MODEL = 'jev-1.13.0' — pinned, because aliases move and thresholds are tuned per version（与官方建议一致）
architecture.prompting: INTENT_CRITERIA 每个选项 {what, not_for, examples}——对比式描述让 Choice 更 sharp
architecture.policy: src/policy.js 是 if statements over probabilities——'Change a number, not a prompt'
architecture.tests: npm run test:integration 27/27 real-API 用例，latency avg ≈ 330 ms；demo:ci 16 条口述命令 headless 断言 URL
